changelog:
## What's New in v6.3.8

### New
- Templates panel down the left of the annotation page. It can be resized (drag its edge), hidden, and its tiles shown small in a wide grid or large in a narrow column.
- Dictionary tab: your templates grouped by species, sorted for the event in hand (its label and suggestion first), by how common the species is here, or A-Z; species search; star species into a shortlist; click a species to see and play all its templates; one click labels the selected event(s).
- Xeno-canto tab: search any bird and see the spectrograms of its Xeno-canto recordings, filter by song/call and quality, play them, open them on xeno-canto.org, and label from them. Uses your Xeno-canto API key.
- iNaturalist tab: search any bird, no key needed. Spectrograms are drawn in the app from research-grade iNaturalist sound recordings, with playback and a link to each observation.

Includes 6.3.7 (Compare with file Show filter, spectrogram retry) and 6.3.6 (Compare with file with Excel/PDF reports, staying signed in).
